description: Semantic audit rules flag economically questionable matches without changing collection, panel membership, indices, charts, or the README diagram.

rules.reason: The published label is Beyaz ekmek, while these modifiers describe specialty/non-white breads.
rules.suggestion: Either tighten the type to ordinary white bread or explicitly rename its scope to Somun ekmek before changing the index methodology.

rules.reason: İçme sütü is intended as the plain-milk basket; lactose-free has its own type and flavored milk behaves as a different product.
rules.suggestion: Add sibling/flavor exclusions only after checking coverage impact.

rules.reason: Premixed coffee drinks are not equivalent to plain soluble/granulated coffee even when the source category says Granül Kahve.
rules.suggestion: Separate plain granulated coffee from premixes; do not tighten until enough plain SKUs are available.

rules.reason: These are valid vinegars but represent materially different submarkets and price levels.
rules.suggestion: Keep if the intended scope is all vinegar; otherwise split or narrow later.

rules.reason: Flavored/dibek variants can have different pricing dynamics from ordinary Turkish coffee.
Spray packaging is a distinct format with a large packaging premium per litre.
rules.suggestion: Review only; fixed-SKU relatives reduce the immediate bias.

rules.reason: The generic Köfte type currently mixes poultry and red-meat products.
rules.suggestion: Keep only if Köfte is intentionally species-agnostic.
